update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.3 - Changelog
New --- - Make Team Trials pick the opponent with the "With Every Win!" bonus when one is offered, and otherwise the weakest opponent as before.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Ines Fujin (Valentine) 2026-11-09`. - Make the bot faster. The Main screen stats, the Details header and skills, training facilities and skill lists are each read in one pass, and buttons are first checked where they were last seen. - Make Career Setup faster. The trainee list is searched by name order, and the legacy and friend lists scroll quickly and stop at the end. - Curb memory use during long back-to-back career runs. - Stop the bot cleanly when the "Date Changed" dialog shows, since the game then returns to the title screen. - Stop the bot when the game freezes, either on the same turn 30 times in a row or on an unknown screen that stays unchanged for 60 seconds. - Stop the bot when the game shows "Application Updated", since it must be updated through Google Play first. - Report a stop the bot made itself, like a session error or running out of alarm clocks, as stopped by the bot with its reason, instead of "You stopped the bot". - Keep the message log fast on long runs. New lines arrive in batches and the viewer keeps the newest 2,000, while the saved log file keeps everything. - Shorten the waits in Dailies Missions and Presents. - Hide the last run's result on the Home card while the other run mode is selected.
Fixes --- - Fix the bot sometimes starting a training by accident while switching to its tab. - Fix URA Finale training gains misreading the "+" and "1", which read a +14 as 4. - Fix a failed stat read overwriting the stat with -1 until the next good read. - Fix a cut-off final fan count being saved when the last digit was misread. - Fix taps no longer working after the accessibility service restarted mid-run. - Fix buttons not being found on devices whose screenshots have row padding. - Fix training failure chances being misread, such as a 0% read as 13%, 43% or 70%, which made the bot skip a good training or rest for no reason. - Fix turns with a tapped skill hint being logged as "Could not head back" instead of as trainings. - Fix the Pre-Debut countdown reading an 8 as "38". - Fix the run stopping at the end of a career when the trainer to follow is at maximum followers. - Fix Dailies getting stuck on an item request that is still running in the Club. - Fix the Global skill "Pressure" being swapped for a JP-only skill with the same name. If your skill plan picked "Pressure" after the July data update, remove it and add it again.
